scope: Reviewable connection protocol; no new scientific run, integration, server read or source fit in this work.

existing_protocol.freeze: 48 final recommendations before any verifier/truth; completed results are development evidence now.
existing_protocol.target_budget: 362 includes initialization, all new search episodes, objective comparison and terminal safety verification; source and CPU costs excluded and reported separately.

shared_fairness.source_information: Same immutable archived source labels and source-only training selections for the two source-informed priors; disclose all original source calls. No source refit in the bridge.
shared_fairness.initialization: n0=2 common fresh paired f/g episodes at the same two predeclared physical policy coordinates. Share records; debit two episodes to every logical arm.
shared_fairness.observations: Only raw f and g-tau. Fresh repeats form their own batch sample statistics. Keep all prior paid evidence in posterior; do not resummarize old observations as fresh data.
shared_fairness.risk_model: Retain all eight identity likelihoods/weights, every retained positive component, full cross-policy covariance and original raw likelihood. No legacy variance pseudo-label, target sigma estimate or posterior score may silently replace these.
shared_fairness.verification: Same SD16/familywise safety law and objective-comparison debit; per-task paired verifier noise namespace, recommendation fixed before verifier; no verifier sample reuse as search.
shared_fairness.cpu_budget: Separate prospective authorization after measured interface/numerical cost. Current remaining support reserve does not authorize scientific execution.
shared_fairness.ledger: Append new measured CPU and physical episodes to the existing chain; preserve every earlier failure/recovery fee and any negative balance. Reused scientific caches are not charged again.
shared_fairness.target_cap_interpretation: 362 is an upper bound, never a requirement to spend every episode. Source costs and measured process/child CPU remain separate.

phase_0_local_bridge.purpose: Pure interface fixture before any integration; current turn prepares this plan only.
phase_0_local_bridge.bank: Full common public73 candidate library, no target-outcome-selected eight-policy truncation.
phase_0_local_bridge.constraint: restore_full_prior may restore source-only priors on fixed d50 public references; do not replay old paid45/10 updates into fresh tasks (old target updates at :92-104 belong to opened development replay).
requirements: Strip old target observations and start zero-paid prior.
Map old local eight-bank query indices to physical public73 policy coordinates exactly.
Construct all original terminal templates for public73 at arbitrary remaining budget and the new common initialized shortlist/incumbent.
Check source and GP get the identical public73 coordinates and fresh raw records; no integration needed for these interface assertions.
phase_0_local_bridge.claim: A d50 interface bridge only; not high-dimensional optimization completion.

phase_A_static_public73.status: Planned; blocked on phase_0 and separately authorized scientific CPU.
phase_A_static_public73.task_cohort: Reserve a new task/initialization/search/verifier seed block disjoint from all opened six tasks and earlier development; write exact IDs and parameters before generation.
phase_A_static_public73.bank: All public73 policies available to every arm; no response truth supplied to learners.
phase_A_static_public73.query_set: Start with original six physical policies, explicitly mapped to public73, to isolate bank/terminal expansion from query-set expansion.
phase_A_static_public73.batch_note: Both kernel APIs exist, but common selector and fresh paid batch runner still need connection. Neither is registered as a working multiround entrypoint.
phase_A_static_public73.N_gt_n0: Permit at most two paid query rounds, N=2+sum(n_r)<=10 and terminal budget>=352. N>n0 occurs only when an accepted positive net KG query is chosen; all-stop outcomes with N=2 are retained.
phase_A_static_public73.per_round: Before comparing any query, freeze current full73 terminal bank, shortlist/incumbent and budget-dependent action class; STOP is valued in exactly that class. Compare all registered (q,n) against stop after debiting n episodes. Execute at most one chosen fresh batch and update raw posterior. Rebuild/freeze the next round only after that paid update.
phase_A_static_public73.selector: Choose greatest accepted positive net KG among all six queries and n in{1,4}, deterministic registered-order tie break. If any required comparison is numerical HOLD, freeze no decision and do not execute physical observations/verification. Current adjacent-rule checks remain diagnostics, not a new ranking certificate.
phase_A_static_public73.terminal_remaining: 362-(2+sum(n_r)); include original objective-comparison overhead inside terminal action budgets.
phase_A_static_public73.stop_controls: Each prior has its n0-only terminal recommendation under the same73 bank and original verification law, using360 remaining episodes. Per-round stop is additionally logged as a counterfactual value for that arm, not as a new physical verifier arm.
phase_A_static_public73.method_name: Receding one-step raw KG; no claim of multistep Bellman optimality.
phase_A_static_public73.verification_barrier: All4 tasks x1 predeclared layout x4 arm recommendations frozen before any verifier or truth scoring call.
phase_A_static_public73.physical_maximum: 4 tasks x1 predeclared layout x4 arms x362 logical episodes minus24 duplicated initialization debits =5768 physical episodes upper bound with8 shared physical initialization episodes. Each query debit reduces its own terminal allowance; no additional terminal budget is created. Any additional layout is budgeted separately.
phase_A_static_public73.interpretation: Two rounds is a minimal engineering/development demonstration of N>n0 only. A longer scientific main experiment requires a separately frozen horizon and task/seed cohort.
phase_A_static_public73.layouts: One predeclared public73 layout only; choose/freeze the layout before new task generation. A second layout requires separate CPU and physical budget.

phase_B_high_dimensional_generation.status: Planned; blocked until callable source fields and generator/raw adapter are implemented and reviewed.
phase_B_high_dimensional_generation.source_field_gap: Current raw restore depends on frozen public_mean_reference/public_reference_psi arrays. Add a source-only callable feature/function-prior evaluation at arbitrary generated high-dimensional policies, preserving identity/component/cross-covariance laws. Shape adaptation or reusing d50 arrays is insufficient.
phase_B_high_dimensional_generation.proposal_contract: Freeze one common generator, options, random stream convention and compute allowance for source/GP. Legacy proposal scores that consume target_sigma_mean or old posterior objects require a raw-observation adapter, or an explicitly common source/public-only driver. Generated candidates have no free target response labels.
phase_B_high_dimensional_generation.candidate_freeze: At each paid-update boundary generate/append candidates using only the arm own paid history and frozen public/source data, then freeze query and terminal pool before KG/STOP evaluation. Preserve already sampled policies and empirical incumbent. Do not share the other arm paid data. No unexplained eight-point truncation.
phase_B_high_dimensional_generation.fairness_interpretation: Same algorithmic proposal rule with different own paid histories may produce different candidate trajectories; this evaluates full algorithms. A pure prior comparison requiring identical pools must use a source/public-only fixed proposal schedule and be labeled separately.
phase_B_high_dimensional_generation.query_expansion: Generated candidates become eligible queries and terminal policies under the same (q,n) selector; register exact generator output count/options and treatment of duplicates before the fresh task block.
phase_B_high_dimensional_generation.N_gt_n0_and_budget: Keep phase_A multiround/cap/stop rules; report N, new unique policy coordinates, repeated-policy episodes and candidate-bank changes. At least new policy generation and candidate access must be evidenced; d50 finite-bank success alone does not pass this phase.
phase_B_high_dimensional_generation.truth_separation: Use a separate fresh unopened task block after source-field/generator contract freezes. Previously opened six tasks may validate fixtures only and never become confirmation again.

missing_connections: Fresh paid repeated-batch execution and durable per-round debit records.
Terminal shortlist/action rebuilding and freeze at every remaining budget.
Raw posterior covariance extension at generated high-dimensional policies.
Final recommendation barrier for the complete task-arm block.
primary_analysis: Task-paired sourceKG minus same-source GP KG and eachKG minus own n0 stop, all at362 targetepisodes. Report actual verified safe reward, false certificates, rejected recommendations, source/target/CPU costs, number of policy changes and N. Four-task development size is feasibility/negative-evidence only, not stable superiority confirmation.
not_authorized_now: Any project import or scientific execution
cache_reuse: Reuse compatible source fits, frozen encoders/reference coordinates, raw observation records and exact-matching numerical cases. Candidate/action/state changes do not inherit unmatched old integral certificates.
